questions.q: True or false? You look for the defender before the pass arrives.
questions.explain: Yes. Looking early tells you if you can turn.
choiceExplanations: Yes. Looking early tells you if you can turn.
Look before the ball comes, so you already know where the defender is.

questions.q: You get the ball with room ahead. Put the steps in order.
questions.explain: Right. Look first, receive open, turn, then look up again.
choiceExplanations: Right. Look first, receive open, turn, then look up again.
Receive after you have looked, so you know where the defender is.
Turn only once the ball is at your feet.
Look up again last, while you move with the ball.

questions.q: The defender is far away this time. What do you do?
questions.explain: Yes. The defender is far, so you can turn into the room.
choiceExplanations: There is room ahead, so passing straight back wastes a chance to move forward.
Yes. The defender is far, so you can turn into the room.
Waiting lets the defender run back and close you down.
